narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The first common multiple of four and six is twenty four, because I multiply four by six.
<bookmark mark='twelve'/>But twelve is in the list of fours, and in the list of sixes too.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Twelve comes before twenty four, so twenty four cannot be the first one.
